gitCommit.subject: Rebuild the savings, debts, and goals forms; fix dark-mode contrast
gitCommit.body:
Rebuild the savings, debts, and goals forms; fix dark-mode contrast

The category and bank-account pickers were unreadable in dark mode: on selection
the summary got `text-slate-900` with no dark variant, on a button whose dark
background is also slate-900. Measured 1.22:1 — the text and background were the
same colour, and only a hover lightening the background made it legible. It also
read "2 selected", hardcoded English in a Spanish UI. It now lists the selected
names with a count badge (shown only at 2+, where truncation can hide items), at
13.34:1. dark-mode.spec.ts gains a real contrast assertion — canvas rasterises
the app's oklch colours to sRGB so the ratio can be computed; it fails at 1.22
with the bug reintroduced.

The forms themselves were a flat list of blocks in a two-column grid, so any
odd-numbered row left a void. They are now grouped into labelled sections, and
every row is paired: the debts payment terms became one three-field row, and
each field row uses CSS subgrid so labels, inputs and help text share rows and
stay aligned even when a label wraps.

Four near-identical 80-line multi-select blocks collapse into one partial, and
the colour picker into another — net -157 lines despite the new sections.

Bugs found while working in these files:

- Goals could never set a debt strategy. `toggleDebtFields` guarded on a
  `debtFields` target that no markup anywhere declares, so it always returned
  early and the selector stayed hidden — on a field the form marks required.
- All six desktop wrappers (goals/savings/debts × new/edit) were missing their
  `data-controller`; only the mobile block had it. Safe to add: `checkChanges`
  early-returns without a `submitButton` target, which desktop does not have.
- Duplicate YAML keys silently shadowed live ones, so English rendered
  "Statement File" as an index heading, "Description" as the transactions
  subtitle, and "Created" as the category flash. Both locales now have zero
  shadowing duplicates. `dashboard.chart_render_error` was missing outright.
- 44 stray `dark:bg-slate-900` tokens across 23 files, from a find/replace that
  appended a base background after a hover one — all 44 were the identical
  triplet, while the same hover class appears 50 other times without it. Two
  toggle tracks were slate-800 on slate-800 cards, i.e. invisible.
- The `:completed` savings and `:paid_off` debts factory traits still set
  `current_amount`/`current_balance`. Those became derived caches, so
  recalculate_balance! overwrote them on create and flipped completed → active.
  That was the one failing spec in the suite.

Verified: 2740 examples 0 failures, 94 e2e 0 failures, rubocop clean, 145 i18n
keys resolve in both locales, and the forms round-trip every moved field.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
